title: P2LRN Common Cartridge Profile
description: Preserves IMS/1EdTech Common Cartridge packages, including legacy cartridges, while projecting organization items and resource types into the P2LRN graph.
rules: The original cartridge SHOULD be preserved byte-for-byte when available.

Internal cartridge paths MAY contain legacy names, spaces or characters that are not valid P2LRN outer-container paths; preserving the cartridge as one content-addressed payload is therefore conformant.
Organization/item ordering SHOULD be projected into P2LRN children ordering.
Resource-specific semantics such as QTI, Basic LTI, discussion topics and web links remain governed by their cartridge contracts unless converted by a dedicated profile.
A lossless round-trip processor MUST preserve unrecognized cartridge resources even if it cannot execute them.
